description:
Found by fz-kdt.63's adversarial review via canonical-form comparison
(fz-f98.21 --dump backend, base vs commit, all 574 fixtures): removing the
analysis's retract-and-remint churn moved the emitted inventory on 6 fixtures,
in BOTH directions. enum_take_drop_split IMPROVED (237 -> 214 executables; 32
widened activations replaced by 7 precise). enum_predicate_search WIDENED
(207 -> 221; fourteen extra activations keyed on the union
int | :false | :ok | :true, incl. Kernel.fz_op_lt/2 and fz_op_eq/2 with boxed
Any marshals, all live in the artifact). Program OUTPUT is identical
everywhere (stdout byte-equal on all 574).

Mechanism: ActivationMap::define_return (semantic.rs:930-937) replaces
evidence and resets slot.ascents = 0 ONLY when rebased -- rebasing is the
sole narrowing path for return evidence and the sole reset of the
RETURN_WIDENING_BUDGET ladder (semantic.rs:967-971). The retraction churn
fz-kdt.63 removed was, by accident, exercising that path (rebased
AnalyzeActivation completions collapsed 183 -> 9 on take_drop_split, 71 -> 2
on predicate_search). With the churn gone the join-only ascent runs unchecked
on some programs; larger inputs sit closer to the convergence_class/any
widening cliff.

Fix direction: the ladder needs an EXPLICIT reset tied to what it actually
measures (consecutive ascents without new ground), not an accident of
retraction. E.g. reset ascents when the activation's INPUT evidence is
unchanged across an evaluation (the ascent stalled on its own), or drive the
budget off distinct input generations. Design carefully against
feedback_unknown_is_not_none and the convergence-by-construction work
(fz-rh2).

Watch in place: canon_test.rs::backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_
target_fixtures pins 59/221/214 executables in both directions -- a drop is an
improvement worth re-pinning with cause; a rise is the ladder running away.
When this ticket lands, enum_predicate_search should return toward 207 and
the pin re-lowers (lowering pins is safe-by-construction).
title: Return-widening ladder resets only on rebase: narrowing depended on retraction churn
